USP is a single Ethereum deployment (100% of supply) at 0x098697ba3fee4ea76294c5d6a466a4e3b3e95fe6, an ERC1967 proxy whose implementation slot is 0x9e40b6be5affc984f36cf118c778f0a83be20370 (ERC20IssuanceUpgradeable_Blacklist_v1). At block 26224775 (Unix 1792390631) name()='USP Yield Optimized Stablecoin', totalSupply=4,350,598.45048, owner()=0x3D7DBEC2f6bEe780f6c5Dad61a7a905239e9E61a. The verified implementation overrides _update to revert when isBlacklisted(from) or isBlacklisted(to), and exposes addToBlacklist/removeFromBlacklist behind onlyBlacklistManager, with setBlacklistManager restricted to the owner. Blacklist manager 0xba20ecff64874cf77604c8bfd890f50e3e5b306f was enabled (BlacklistManagerUpdated true at block 23195674) and isBlacklistManager() returns true; two accounts are currently blacklisted (isBlacklisted=true for 0x2ad3ebf1bc9ea5b844e8f9414e3b68982342f92e and 0x3646173e639baaa652a1f59a50b7e310fd5cbba3, AddedToBlacklist at blocks 26167550 and 26167551). This is an active holder-targeted deny with a live manager, so the verdict is Yes.

oracleRisk.summary: USP's Funding Manager reads Piku's Oracle Module at 0x433471901bA1A8BDE764E8421790C7D9bAB33552. Its verified implementation exposes authorized functions to set issuance and redemption prices, and Piku describes it as a manual price feed. A live Chainlink-compatible adapter at 0xb52eb13139905eb11c472100a1e86cb1961b8ef3 returned the same price at the reviewed block, but Piku does not disclose an independent source, cadence, or enforced failover; a separate documented adapter address reverted on standard reads.

branchApplicability.reviewer: OpenAI Codex V9.17 oracle applicability review
branchApplicability.rationale: USP is an issuer-operated, KYC-gated NAV product, not a permissionless CDP with borrower collateral and liquidation branches. Its Funding Manager nevertheless calculates minting, redemption, and yield from the Oracle Module's authorized issuance and redemption prices; Piku's dated price example also identifies the Chainlink-compatible adapter as the canonical USP valuation reference. Those prices are a price-sensitive top-level issuance/redemption authority that must be scored without inventing liquidation branches.
